description: Header file defining the ConnectorType class and ConnectorController singleton for RPC communication in Thunder namespace, including external server proxies and communication management.

classes.name: ConnectorController
classes.description: Singleton class managing a Core::IUnknown controller reference, with thread-unsafe assumptions.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class managing communication channels via RPC, with nested Channel class handling connection state.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Sets and AddRef's the controller pointer.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Releases and nullifies the controller pointer.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Returns the current controller pointer with AddRef.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires an interface pointer from a communication channel.

methods.name: Communicator
methods.description: Returns a ProxyType to the CommunicatorClient for a given node.

methods.name: Engine
methods.description: Returns a reference to the RPC engine server.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Virtual method to set operational state.
